bill.title: A resolution designating June 23, 2025, as "Social Media Harms Victim Remembrance Day".
bill.latestActionText: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S4511; text: CR S4508)
bill.officialSummary: This resolution designates June 23, 2025, as Social Media Harms Victim Remembrance Day and encourages government, industry, and community stakeholders to take action to prevent social media-related harm.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation.
